E9 · Agent & Runtime Routing

the lane and runtime map: which AI lane or runtime executes which class of work, under which demonstrated capability

Purpose

Route each task to the lane whose demonstrated capability matches it.

Strategy

Route by demonstrated capability, never assumption; runtime activation stays HELD to its own authority.

Assets

The lane capability register and routing decision records.

Mesh participation (all nine stages)

1 Signal — What EntersWork needing execution, lane capability changes and routing failures.
2 InterpretationWhich lane/runtime is capable and authorised for a task.
3 StructuringRouting entries binding task class to lane with authority notes.
4 ValidationCapability evidence checks; no route asserts access a lane has not demonstrated.
5 Action PermittedDispatch work to lanes; record handoffs with packets.
6 ObservationHandoff outcomes, lane failures and capability drift.
7 LearningWhere routing assumptions failed and which need re-verification.
8 Asset ConversionProven routing rules qualify toward the Method library.
9 Feedback Returns ToRouting outcomes return to Orient and the Work Object queue.
